newsitem.title: INDIA: Saudi, Kazakh planes collide near Delhi - PTI.
newsitem.headline: Saudi, Kazakh planes collide near Delhi - PTI.

text.p: A Saudi Arabian jumbo jet and a Kazakhstan airliner collided in mid-air near Delhi on Tuesday and there were fears of many deaths, the Press Trust of India (PTI) reported.
PTI said the Saudi Airways Boeing 747 collided with a Kazakh Airways TU-154 airplane 40 nautical miles west of New Delhi.
"Heavy casualties are feared," PTI quoted Air Force officials as saying.
Airport officials said they were checking the report.
"We have heard something but we're not quite sure what exactly has happened," one aviation official said.
India frequently leases aircraft from Central Asian countries, including Kazakhstan. It was not immediately clear if the plane involved in the accident was one of these.
